# Zambian Outdoor Adventure Company

> Lusaka-based adventure company offering scuba diving with PADI-certified instructors (Hennie Smit, Jonathan Chiwenu), wilderness expeditions and technical rescue training across Zambia. Founded 2023 on Lake Tanganyika.

Key facts: Try Scuba K1,500 (age 6+), Discover Scuba Diving K2,200 (age 10+), Pond Scuba K2,500 full day (age 10+). The company is not a PADI dive centre; its instructors are individually PADI-certified. Try Scuba and Discover Scuba take 3–4 hours. No swimming required. Maximum 4 people per group. Lusaka venues: Millennium Village, GOGO Fitness, Radisson Blu Hotel, or the customer's own pool. Dive locations: Lusaka pools, Chisamba, Mulungushi Dam, Tiffany's Canyon, Lake Tanganyika (Isanga Bay, Mpulungu). Open Water Diver course coming soon (USD 550). Contact: info@zambianadventures.com, WhatsApp +260 97 972 7627.
